name: Ho Jong Son

attribution.legal_posture: designated under E.O. 13694, as further amended, and E.O. 13810; North Korean banker; Treasury reported that he and Jang Kuk Chol helped manage funds, including a collective $5.3 million in cryptocurrency, on behalf of First Credit Bank; this is an administrative sanctions designation, with no criminal charge or conviction on record.

caveats: Administrative designation and Treasury-reported collective conduct describe the status; this record carries administrative status only. The $5.3 million cryptocurrency aggregate and downstream ransomware/IT-worker-revenue linkage apply jointly to Ho Jong Son and Jang Kuk Chol, with the aggregate unallocated to Ho. First Credit Bank is reported in an on-behalf-of relationship; the source gives relationship context without employment, office, or personal ownership findings for its accounts or wallets. North Korea is designation-era exact-entry context; residence and present location require separate sources. The record retains only the aggregate finding and excludes account, wallet, address, transaction, victim, counterparty, passport, birth, nationality, gender, contact, precise address, and other sensitive selectors.
Administrative sanctions listing; the record carries no criminal conviction.
The source supplies its recorded transliterations; an alias transfers to a same-name person or entity only when the source explicitly links it.

Exact-ID merge only: each retained value is explicitly attached by the cited official dataset to the same sanctions-list entry; values stay attached to that entry pending a source bridge to any same-name subject.
SDN.CSV and ALT.CSV are component tables of one OFAC Sanctions List Service dataset/source family; count them as one source family.

identity_boundary: Ho Jong Son, listed by OFAC as HO, Jong Son with the alternate romanization HO', Cho'ng So'n, is the North Korean banker described in Treasury's November 2025 sanctions action. The funds were reportedly managed collectively with Jang Kuk Chol on behalf of First Credit Bank; the record preserves the administrative-designation posture, while criminal case, precise present location, bank-wallet ownership, and same-named public-account ownership remain unreported.
